text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf's dreams have been<n>dashed, but
she won't give up. Her<n>sights stay firmly fixed on
the future.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She resolves to prove her worth in<n>the Kikuka Sho,
but her packed<n>schedule is starting to take its toll,
and<n>Air Groove is only getting more<n>concerned.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As usual, however, it's Symboli<n>Rudolf's way or
the highway. Even a<n>grueling race can't keep her
from her<n>student council duties.
